messages:
Alice: Quick check — infra-canary is spitting out verbose traces that sometimes include customer identifiers. Ops wants to drop retention from 90d -> 14d to cut S3 costs. Any compliance/security blockers?

Ben: @Alice we need to classify those traces: request logs vs debug-only artifacts. If PII exists, default policy requires 90d.

Chloe (compliance): Policy excerpt: https://redwood-internal/policy/data-retention — default for request traces is 90 days. Debug snapshots can be 14 days only if scrubbed of PII and an exception is approved.

Heather: What exactly is showing up in the canary traces? customer IDs in headers or whole request bodies? If it's only latency/span metadata + non-identifying tags, 14d is fine.

Frank: Current S3 lifecycle for traces (example):
```json
{
  "Rule": [{"ID": "request-traces","Prefix": "traces/canary/","Expiration": {"Days": 90}}]
}
```
We can add another rule for `traces/canary/debug/` -> Days: 14.

Alice: Example trace line: `customer_id=acct_12345` and sometimes the full request body for failed canaries. We do have a scrubber but it's not consistently run on all jobs. :grimacing: 

Chloe (compliance): To approve 14d we need: 1) automated scrubbing in CI that removes `customer_id`, emails, IPs; 2) sampling policy so we don't keep full payloads for sampled failures; 3) a compliance approval ticket with scrub logs attached.

Ben: Scrubber pattern we use: 
```regex
(customer_id|user_email|ip_address)[:=]\\S+
```
Plan: add `trace-scrubber --rules canary` as a pipeline step.

Heather: Also please gate access — put traces older than 7 days into a restricted bucket or add an IAM condition requiring `auditor` role to read. That limits exposure while retention still exists.

Alice: I'll file an exception request CR-8921 and open a PR to add the scrubber + lifecycle rule. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

devops-bot: Pipeline `infra-canary` will run after PR merge — https://ci.redwood/infra-canary/5678 :rocket:

Frank: If we need to quickly reduce risk, I can run a one-off redaction job to replace existing `customer_id` values with `<redacted>` across `traces/canary/` (mapreduce job).

Chloe (compliance): Sounds good. Attach sample scrub logs to CR-8921 and tag me. Once I confirm samples, I'll sign off on 14d for scrubbed debug traces. :white_check_mark:

Alice: Thanks — will follow up when CR and PR are up. :thumbsup:
